author: xNemoII
body:
Dear avicus staff,

So I recently got warned by FrozenThorn for language. However, I was very angry at some people because they were being rude to my friends. Also I didn't get a verbal warning first. I know it wasn't the smartest of move and I acted childish but I feel I didn't deserve the warn.

Thanks for taking your time to read this,
nemo

title: My appeal

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

Being angry is no excuse to use foul language. In addition, the Moderator isn't required to give verbal warning. This infraction is valid and will not be appealed.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
